svg.text: Simulated devices — the drone ground station's on-screen display (SD-S2, DESIGN_Simulated_Devices §3.13c, D-111)
Full colour = SPECIFIED by this mockup · grey dashed + 'unchanged' = CONTEXT, not specified · the camera picture behind is illustrative.
specified OSD element (full colour, dark halo — the station's HudText over the view)
Frames are 640 × 360 (16:9), the view riding the drone's camera (DeviceView, D-109). Layout positions are PROPOSALS where the design is silent.
12 · DRONE STATION, flying by hand — the OSD over the drone's camera (dv-drone-fly)
Scope: the mode chip, armed state, battery, link bars, the heading tape, the gimbal scale, the centre mark, altitude ·
speed · distance home, the command line, the VIEW label.
MANUAL chip (green: the link is good) + ARMED · battery 78 % (green > 30 %, amber ≤ 30 %, red ≤ 15 %) · link
bars 4/4 · heading tape with the heading under the gold caret · gimbal pitch −30° on the left scale · centre
mark · ALT (above ground) · SPD · ⌂ distance home · TAKEOFF / LAND / RTH, the active one lit · VIEW ▸
the operator's unit lines · the camera picture
The station's compass strip is NOT drawn while the view rides the drone: the OSD's heading tape is the drone's heading (the
PROPOSAL: the mode chip top-left, battery and link top-right, readouts bottom-centre, commands bottom-right (as the
13 · BATTERY LOW — the warning, and the drone flying home (dv-drone-battery-out)
Scope: the battery in red, the warning banner, the RTH command lit (the operator pressed it, or the type returns on its
own — the design leaves that to the GCS's mode).
battery 12 % in red (blinks by frame count) · the BATTERY LOW banner with the warning glyph · the RTH
chip (amber) and the RTH command lit · distance home counting down
the operator's unit lines · the camera picture
At 0 % the drone comes down where it is (D-107, the existing rule) — the banner then reads BATTERY EMPTY.
PROPOSAL: the warning threshold (15 %) and the banner under the heading tape are mine; the design names a battery warning,
14 · LINK LOST — jammed: the failsafe hovers, then flies home (dv-drone-jammed)
Scope: the darkened last picture, LINK LOST, the reason (JAMMED or out of range), the failsafe's countdown and next
step, the link bars at zero.
FAILSAFE: hover 3 s ▸ return home ▸ land
the last picture held and darkened · LINK LOST (red) with the glyph · the reason: JAMMED
(DroneLink.Jammed) or OUT OF RANGE · the failsafe's countdown and its next steps · FAILSAFE chip
(red) · link bars 0 (red) · readouts greyed (the last values the link carried)
Sticks do nothing while the link is lost (D-107); the commands are hidden. The link back ⇒ the GCS's mode again and the live
PROPOSAL: holding the last picture darkened (rather than black or 'snow') is mine — it keeps the operator oriented; the
design names LINK LOST and the failsafe, not the look.
15 · PAUSED — the OSD still answers, nothing moves (dv-drone-paused)
Scope: the same OSD in pause with the command menu opened by a press; the battery and the drone hold still. The
the OSD answering in pause: the command menu opens, LAND chosen and shown QUEUED (R-4300: a mode
press is a world effect — it runs on the first live frame) · CAM DOWN works (gimbal −45°, the view tilts —
observation) · SPD 0.0 · the battery holds at 78 %
the toolbar's run controls (paused) · the operator's unit lines · the picture
No in-view PAUSED banner (as panel 5): the toolbar is the pause cue. Judged by dv-drone-paused: position and DroneBattery
PROPOSAL: the 'queued' note in the menu row is mine; the design says the press waits for the first live frame, not how the
